title: PilotProject
description: Stage 11 operational entity: a regional coordination umbrella that organizes existing capability-strengthening activities (Stage 10 interventions, Stage 5 organizations / training programs / practitioners, Stage 8 workshops) in a defined regional scope. A pilot COORDINATES; it never re-governs: it holds no outcome field of any kind, and the outcomes of constituent interventions remain governed by Stage 10. Exactly ONE Stage 11 entity: no Region, PilotOutcome, PilotParticipant, PilotMetric, PilotScore, PilotPriority, PilotMeasurement or any other shadow entity exists. Regional scope is expressed only through canonical Stage 1 Location references; there is no Region entity and no geographic RBAC. census_snapshot_id references an immutable Stage 6 snapshot (a dated 'began against' reference, never a live baseline). Lifecycle: PROPOSED -> APPROVED -> ACTIVE -> CONCLUDED with CANCELLED reachable from PROPOSED/APPROVED/ACTIVE; CONCLUDED and CANCELLED are terminal and immutable; no resurrection and no RETIRED state. No fabricated data.

objective.description: What the pilot coordinates toward (required for approval).

status.description: Coordination lifecycle. APPROVED may have zero constituents (plan-first); ACTIVE requires at least one valid constituent activity (intervention, organization, workshop or training program). CONCLUDED is an administrative terminal state that NEVER implies success; CANCELLED is terminal with a mandatory recorded reason. No outcome field exists on a pilot.

location_ids.description: Canonical Stage 1 Location references. The displayed regional label derives from / is validated against these records; no Region entity, no free-floating regional identity, no invented coordinates.

intervention_ids.description: Constituent Stage 10 CapabilityIntervention references. Many-to-many membership that transfers NO authority: adding/removing a pilot never modifies the intervention; Stage 10 remains the sole authority over intervention lifecycle and outcome.

practitioner_ids.description: Stage 5 Practitioner references, subject to the existing privacy/masking rules everywhere; references only, never shadow records.

census_snapshot_id.description: Optional reference to an IMMUTABLE Stage 6 census snapshot: 'this pilot began against Census Snapshot X' — dated, versioned in the UI, never modified or regenerated here, never a live baseline.

reviewer.description: Approver identity (never the creator; creator/approver separation applies at every role level including NATIONAL).

version.description: History/architecture bookkeeping (audited amendments and transitions; the full audit trail lives in audit_log).
